biography.plain_text: Roman Arkadyevich Abramovich is a Russian-born businessman and investor whose fortune took shape during the post-Soviet privatization of state assets. In 1995, he and partners acquired control of oil producer Sibneft; a decade later he sold a 73% stake to Gazprom. He later diversified through holdings in steel and nickel, served as governor of Chukotka, and became internationally known through his 19-year ownership of Chelsea F.C.
